_README: AirDNA MarketMinder calibration for the Ocean Grove STR report.
TO USE: copy this file to  data/ocean_grove/airdna_market.json  and replace the
numbers below with figures from your AirDNA MarketMinder dashboard for Ocean Grove.
The generator auto-detects data/ocean_grove/airdna_market.json (override path with
$OG_AIRDNA_JSON) and calibrates every listing's STR revenue to it, falling back to
the built-in seasonal model for any bedroom count you leave out.
Where to find each number in MarketMinder: open the Ocean Grove market, then filter
by bedroom count. Copy 'Average Annual Revenue' (best), and/or 'ADR' + 'Occupancy'.
annual_revenue wins if present; otherwise adr x occupancy x 365 is used.
occupancy is a fraction (0.55 = 55%). Delete this _README block if you like.
